sections.title: Housing
data: The Coast Guard relies mainly on local rentals and owns housing only where the community cannot meet its needs. Where Coast Guard housing exists, assignment is generally mandatory when a home is available.
We found no official count of Coast Guard homes at North Bend. Ask the sector's local housing officer about government housing before you sign a lease.
